about_text.name: about_text
about_text.default: 'The One Roof began as a single shop in Guntur and grew through Telugu-language Shorts: budget wall clocks, double bumper shoe offers, Krishnashtami specials. Orders arrived over WhatsApp, one chat thread at a time. This storefront is that same shop — same buyer, same prices, same Guntur address.'
